program_name: Ultra-Poor Graduation Program in Burkina Faso
intervention_description: Multifaceted program targeting ultra-poor households with cash transfers, asset transfers, and nutrition interventions for households with pregnant women and children under 5

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Cash transfers of $36/month during lean season used primarily for food purchases
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Animal transfers and agricultural tool purchases included
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: No specific social empowerment activities described

outcomes.outcome_description: Predicted probability of being classified as ultra-poor
outcomes.literal_text: Ultra-poverty remained 29% lower in the T3 group relative to the control

outcomes.outcome_description: Index of agricultural tools and equipment owned
outcomes.literal_text: Significant impact on agriculture index mainly from tool purchases

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage points of severe food insecurity
outcomes.literal_text: Severe food insecurity decreased by 5 to 8 percentage points across treatment groups
outcomes.text_position: Food security, nutrition and anthropometrics section

outcomes.outcome_description: Severe stunting reduction in percentage points
outcomes.literal_text: Severe stunting is down by 3.3 pp from an average of 12.8 i.e. 26% decline

outcomes.outcome_description: Additional years of education aspired for children
outcomes.literal_text: T3 households hope to acquire 1.4 more years of education for their children

outcomes.outcome_description: Standardized dietary diversity score for pregnant/lactating women
outcomes.literal_text: Women in T3 exhibit significantly better dietary diversity (+0.31 SD)
